d: Joe Dispenza, an expert in the intersection of science and mindfulness, walks us through the importance of meditation and mental rehearsal in creating positive change and mind and body ‘cohesiveness'.
Author, life coach and viral content creator Jay Shetty gives his fundamental rules on every aspect of love, from rejuvenating a marriage to laying the all important foundation of self love.

Scott Galloway is one of the most influential business thought leaders in the world. Host of The Prof G Show and author of four New York Times bestselling books, he discusses how he sees business leadership and more.
Raphael Rowe, host of ‘Inside the World's Toughest Prisons' on Netflix and a wrongfully convicted ex-prisoner himself, talks about what his experience taught him about life, and about himself.
